task.title: Stop browser tests failing on the macOS CI runner when Chrome will not start
task.description:
On the macos-15 runner, Verify failed on PRs #222 and #223 with browser tests reporting 'Chrome never wrote .../DevToolsActivePort' or 'the browser driver did not finish within 1m0s, so it and Chrome were killed'. The tests differ from run to run (TestBrowserSettlesAChangeThatLandedBeforeItsResend, TestBrowserPhoneRulesStayBelowTheBreakpoint, TestBrowserDueMarksAreJudgedAgainAtTheReadersMidnight) and pass on rerun and on Ubuntu. In the failing runs internal/cli took 18 to 37 minutes, so the runner was overloaded.

Find out why Chrome fails to start there (too many Chrome instances at once across parallel browser tests is the likely cause, not proven) and fix it at the source: for example a limit on concurrent browser sessions shared by the webui browser tests, or one retry of a browser launch that never came up. A rerun costs about 40 minutes of CI each time this happens.

Logs saved during the run: job 137415069800 (run 45089333397) and job 137484424760 (run 45111431286).
